claims.summary: For two double roots A!=B of the degree-two pair space, the naive derivative rows phi_A phi_B, phi_A' phi_B, phi_A phi_B', phi_A' phi_B' span only S0=(1+AT)^(-5/2)(1+BT)^(-5/2) Pol_(<=2) (dimension 3), since T=((1+AT)-(1+BT))/(A-B). The pair block <phi_A,phi_(A+delta)>.<phi_B,phi_(B+eta)> has no joint limit: for generic A!=B, with A exact the limit is V7=(1+AT)^(-5/2)(1+BT)^(-7/2) Pol_(<=3), with B exact the mirror (1+AT)^(-7/2)(1+BT)^(-5/2) Pol_(<=3); the whole-space limits also differ in the half-integral class.
claims.assessment: Working proof of the dependency and of the limit V7, using phi_A'-gamma phi_A = c(1+AT)^(-5/2)(1+BT); the escape of the order-eta^3 term from S0 (a polynomial condition) is checked exactly at (A,B)=(1,2) via Pluecker vectors, with the mirror; rank 9 of 10 (N=5) and 14 of 15 (N=6) for the naive rows.
claims.rationale: Shows the collision-pattern classes of conj:cube-pair-degeneration-simplicity need a direction once two double roots share a pair block, as in the bubble of the confluent cluster degeneration.

relationships: The pattern classes with two double roots are not canonical.
